clue.text: In story about quiet island …

Iona is a small island in the Inner Hebrides off western Scotland

explanation.walkthrough: 'In' looks like a link word but is the whole definition, as in 'the in thing'. IONA is a Scottish Hebridean island.

clue.text: At home, guest ultimately discourteous to butt in

clue.text: Make like a European? Nice one — perhaps!
